title: A Day With My Family
text: I have a big family. My brother and my sister live with me. He likes soccer, and she likes to sing. We often play together after school. Our dog is friendly, and its tail wags when it sees us. Sometimes my friends visit me. I give them cookies, and they say thank you. On my birthday, everyone gives me gifts. My mother says everything is ready, and I feel there is nothing better than a day with my family!
